why: The strip's rule stops reading the marker, so an FFA entry draws the `marks` row under the reversal value `solid` (which resolves to `null`), under `arcs` and `roof`, and in every injected HUD (issue #1022). The ruling reserved `marks` for a `shape` marker on by default, so that the strip's outlines never appear without the ground ring's; this is the reversed marker drawing marks.
